text:
Alex: Huge news thread incoming  Sofia just dropped two life-updates: promoted to Staff SWE and expecting a baby in November!! :heart:
Sofia: AHH thank you!! We told family this weekend and the promo email came through Monday. Still feels like a surreal combo.
Rohan: WHAT congrats @Sofia!! both are massive. We need a party. :tada:
Priya: omg yes a party. baby shower + promo cake? i can coordinate a little office celebration next Thursday at 3pm.
Sofia: that would be lovely. nothing big, just friends. also feel free to bring salty snacks, crackers are my comfort food.
People-ops-bot: Congrats Sofia! Your new title will be reflected in the org chart. Please check your comp packet and sign the promotion docs. People Ops can advise on parental leave options when you're ready.
Evelyn: so happy for you  congrats on Staff and the baby!! amazing news. :confetti_ball:
Alex: putting a tentative calendar invite for next Thursday 3pm in the 3rd-floor lounge. react with an emoji if you can make it so we can plan cake size.
Rohan: :cake:
Priya: :baby:
Evelyn: :balloon:
Sofia: :heart: thank you everyone. i'll DM anyone who wants registry details or needs more info.
